ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low intensity dominant; approximately 0.08:0.92 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark pixels across the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark contiguous field across both lobes; secondary spatial mapping identifies a cluster of 12-15 discrete high-contrast white circular spots localized on the inner medial section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide U-shaped depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 65 degrees and shallow penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge displays high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations; left lobe edge displays a smoother profile until the distal tip where topography becomes highly irregular and jagged.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Right lobe follows a standard convex curve; left lobe trajectory is linear-to-concave, terminating in a truncated, non-tapered distal boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple high-contrast white circular pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed across the dark field of the right lobe and dense white clusters on both lobe tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distal tip of left lobe shows severe pixel disruption and geometric amputation, characterized by a jagged, high-contrast cluster of irregular masses consistent with heavy barnacle colonization and tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant high-intensity white encrustations along the entire trailing edge tips, creating a high-contrast 'fringe' against the dark ventral pigment and water background.
